effects.intended_material: rubber WORKS stamp on damp sheet

sections.intent: Dry paper roll and T-square, harpsichord establishes G-major sixteenth gear motive.
Two-part108BPM baroque invention; harpsichord lead and bassoon two octaves below imitate. Exploded parts separate on eighth notes, section and reassembly click.
Add spiccato strings/cellos while camera follows coupled mechanical force crank→chain→boom.
Written ritardando, instruments leave one by one; true digital music silence exposes empty-sheet flaw.
Only three sparse questioning notes and pen scratch under the new revision.
Held Dsus4 strings swell twice with soft paper puffs, no voice; cloud gains volume and shadow.
Catch resolves G on downbeat; briefly full invention as net cups real cloud.
Harp and harpsichord rain arpeggios synchronized with droplets and growing flower, soft damped pats.
Full G cadence on WORKS stamp, theme returns in augmentation over title block, final pen-cap click.
